text:
Deploy checklist

Staging first, soak 30 minutes watching http_5xx_rate, then promote to prod. Announce in #logistics-ops.

Webhook retry policy

Failed webhook deliveries retry 5 times with exponential backoff, then land in the dead-letter queue for 30 days.

Incident review template

Timeline, root cause, action items with owners. File within 48 hours of mitigation.

Salary bands FY27

Engineering salary bands for the FY27 compensation cycle. Restricted to engineering leadership.
